description: Build an enhanced due diligence memo for a subject and its wallets: exact-match OFAC wallet screening, subject-name screening against sanctioned parties, sanctions evidence, and follow-up actions, returned as structured JSON or an inline PDF/DOCX artifact. Wallet addresses are optional: without them the memo covers the subject name only and says no wallets were supplied. Use this for case handoff; use wallet_screen for screening-only results. To keep the memo in your account, call saved_results_save with its screening_id. Price without an account: $0.25 per call.

addresses.description: Crypto wallet addresses to screen for OFAC sanctions exposure and include in the enhanced due diligence memo. Optional: leave it out for a memo on the subject name alone, and the memo will say no wallets were supplied.

items.description: Crypto wallet address to screen for OFAC sanctions exposure and include in the enhanced due diligence memo.

artifact_only.description: When output_format is pdf or docx, return a compact artifact-first response without the full memo payload.

asset.description: Optional asset or network ticker filter such as ETH, USDC, XBT, TRX, ARB, or BSC. It never hides a listed address: one listed under another asset is still a match, with assetFilterMatched false in the summary. Letters and digits only, 2 to 10 characters.

case_name.description: Optional case or review title shown in the memo.

jurisdiction.description: Optional jurisdiction or operating region for the case.

lists.description: Sanctions lists to screen against. Defaults to ["ofac_sdn"]. Optional additions: "ofac_consolidated" (OFAC's non-SDN lists), "uk_sanctions" (UK Sanctions List), "eu_consolidated" (EU consolidated financial sanctions list) and "un_consolidated" (UN Security Council list). The UK and EU lists name only a few wallet addresses and the UN list none, so those three mostly matter for subject-name screening in compliance_edd_report. Every match names its list. If a requested list cannot be loaded the call fails instead of returning a partial result.

output_format.description: Select json for the structured memo payload or pdf|docx for a generated artifact.

reference_id.description: Optional internal case or review reference.

requested_by.description: Optional requester, owner, or reviewing team.

response_detail.description: summary (default) returns a short text summary for the model to read; the full result is always in structuredContent. full returns the whole result as JSON text.

review_reason.description: Optional reason the EDD memo is being prepared.

subject_aliases.description: Other names the subject is known by; each is also screened against sanctioned party names and aliases.

subject_name.description: Human-readable subject or counterparty name for the memo.

name: compliance_edd_report

outputSchema.description: Structured due diligence memo: the signed data (decision, evidence, risk factors, name screening, wallet screening) and signed provenance with the screening_id. A generated PDF or DOCX arrives under artifact. With artifact_only, only the file and provenance are returned.

accepts.description: Present when payment is needed: the x402 payment requirements to sign.

artifact.description: Generated PDF or DOCX, when output_format asked for one. downloadUrl is a private link that works for 15 minutes.

artifact_summary.description: Delivery and rendering metadata for the generated file.

artifacts.description: Artifact rendering hints keyed by format.

bucket.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: the limit that was reached.

data.description: Signed memo: case details, workflow status, decision, evidence, risk factors, name screening and the wallet screening.

dataLimitations.description: What the memo does not cover.

decision.description: Risk tier, recommended action and rationale.

nameScreening.description: Subject-name screening: status, matches and parties searched.

severity.description: critical, high, medium, low or informational.

screening.description: Signed screening result. For a single address it has summary, validation and matches; for a batch it has summary counts and one entry per address in results.

indirectExposure.description: Indirect exposure through counterparties, when exposure_depth was set.

matches.description: Sanctioned-entity matches for a single address.

asset.description: Asset or network label on the list.

listName.description: The list the match came from.

results.description: One result per address, for a batch.

query.description: The address as submitted and normalized.

manualReviewRecommended.description: Whether a human should review this row.

matchCount.description: Number of list entries that matched.

status.description: match, clear or invalid_address. clear means no exact match on the lists checked.

sourceFreshness.description: The lists checked, with publication dates and address counts.

summary.description: Single address: status, matchCount. Batch: totalScreened, matchCount, clearCount, invalidCount, workflowStatus.

clearCount.description: Batch: addresses with no exact match.

invalidCount.description: Batch: addresses not valid in format.

matchCount.description: Number of list entries or addresses that matched.

status.description: Single address: match, clear or invalid_address.

valid.description: Whether the address is valid in format.

walletScreening.description: Present when no wallet addresses were supplied: status not_run and the reason.

error.description: Machine-readable error code when the tool fails.

limit.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: the daily limit.

mode.description: test when the call used only the published test inputs.

output.description: Nested renderer output for a generated file.

payer.description: Present when a payment was refused: the paying address.

price.description: Present when payment is needed: the price of the call without an account.

provenance.description: Signed provenance: the screening_id, when it ran, the exact list versions and the signature. Check it with screening_verify.

lists.description: The lists checked, with publication date, address count and SHA-256.

screeningId.description: ID of this screening. Pass it to saved_results_save and screening_verify.

remaining.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: how much was left.

report.description: Report-shaped payload used to build any PDF or DOCX.

resetsAt.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: when it resets (ISO 8601).

retryAfterSeconds.description: Present when the account made too many calls: seconds to wait.

saved.description: Whether the result was kept in the account.

support.description: Present on some errors: where to get help.

testModeNote.description: Plain-words note on a test call.

usage.description: What this call took from the account's daily limits. Present only for signed-in callers.

used.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: how much of it was used today.

verdict.description: Presentation of the outcome, built from the result and not part of the signed data: what was checked, how old the list is and what to do next.

scope.description: The lists checked, with their publication dates and address counts. A no-exact-match status means only this.

status.description: match, no_exact_match, invalid_address (every address invalid) or mixed (a batch with more than one outcome).

x402Version.description: Present when payment is needed: the x402 protocol version.

title: EDD Report
